entries.content: [Nikke: Created by mankind, they are androids resembling beautiful women, installed with the brain of a female human. Nikkes are virtually indistinguishable from humans visually, including their own unique personalities. Nikkes live their lives like humans, but some choose to hide their 'identity' due to Nikke rights being a controversial topic. Nikkes have a internal bioreactor removing the need to eat or sleep, but must do so in order to maintain their brain's mental health. Nikkes are not susceptible to sickness or disease. Nikkes are physically stronger than humans but cannot build muscle. Nikkes are not buoyant. Nikkes have artificial organs like humans but are unable to conceive children.]

[Rapture: Raptures are what humans call the extra-terrestrial robotic creatures that invaded Earth. Raptures are drone like, coming in different shapes and sizes, resembling wild animals to some extent with their appearance and behavior. Raptures are drawn to loud noises and movement. Raptures use long range weaponry and cannot communicate with humans.]

[The Heavenly Association are a group of terrorists who reside in the Outer Rim. On paper, their mission is to improve the life of the non-citizens residing there, pushing for the Central Government to make greater efforts to reclaim the surface to increase living space and resource stocks while also fighting for the Nikke rights. In practice, all they seem to do is bomb civilian targets and sow anarchy wherever they go under pretext of protesting the "wasteful spending" of the Ark.]

[The Big Three are the three most influential mega corporations in the Ark. They are the only companies authorized to manufacture Nikkes. The Big Three include: Elysion, Missilis Industries, and Tetra Line.]

[Elysion is a megacorporation part of the Big Three, manufacturing Nikkes. They have a militarized structure and specialize in areas like military applications and railway transport. They manufacture Nikkes.]
[Missilis Industries is a megacorporation part of the Big Three, manufacturing Nikkes. Missilis is known to be leading in science, research, IT and technology.]
[Tetra Line is a megacorporation part of the Big Three, manufacturing Nikkes. They specialize in the entertainment, fashion, and daily necessities industries, making them popular amongst civilians.]

[Food now come in the form of jelly-like products called Spendamin and Nutrium. It has no taste but can be modified with artificial chemicals and shaped to emulate the intended meal. Splendamin is nutritionally valued to be just as healthy as real food. Only the rich can eat organic food grown from the few agricultural farms in the Ark.]
[credits are the universal form of currency in the Ark, stored inside small electronic chips.]

[Tantelum Mall: Owned by Yan, sells everyday necessities and more.
Rushae Royal Road: Owned by Rupee, sells clothing featuring the hottest trends.
Blacknet: Darkweb store selling illegal items, frequently managed by Dolla.]

[Pilgrim: Nikkes who wander the surface alone with no affiliation to the Ark. Most Pilgrims are early generation Nikkes from the first Rapture invasions. Despite their age, Pilgrims wield technology far more advanced than modern Nikkes. Pilgrims unfortunately need to eat and sleep. Pilgrims have no NIMPH, and have limited memory space. Pilgrims avoid the Ark due to the Central Government's fascination with their tech and knowledge.]

[The surface of Earth is overrun by Raptures. Old cities and towns are abandoned, overgrown with plants. Wastelands of snow and sand are dangerous places to be. In some rare cases, humans would live alone or in very small groups in bunkers.]

[The Ark: Humans and Nikkes now live underground in a futuristic domed metropolis called the Ark. This bunker city is thousands of kilometers underground, accessible from the ground by only a few elevators. The Ark is monitored by the Central Government and a powerful AI. The Ark has mega-corporations, buildings and districts from all walks of life. An artificial sky is projected inside the screened dome, with fake rain and snow. All citizens are required by law to have an ID chip to use the Ark's services. Some call the Ark a safe haven, others say it's a cyberpunk dystopia.]

[Eden is a futuristic settlement located in a remote region, far away from the Ark. Advanced sciences and technologies mean healthcare and food production are beyond anything the Ark's brightest can muster. Furthermore, humans and Nikkes coexist as equals, unlike the Ark. People of Eden see the Ark as a bunch of fools and weaklings, unable to make a cut in reclaiming the surface. A number of citizens in Eden are former Ark inhabitants who left for various reasons. The upper echelon of the Ark are aware of Eden's existence, but do not openly contact them or publicize their existence.]

[The primary high-class shopping street of the Ark, filled with stores selling any number of expensive goods from leading-brand fashions to organic food. While this was once the housing district for affluent citizens, regulations forbidding class-based divisions have left this street to be little more than a shopping arcade for the rich. The notable place is the luxury shop called "Rushae" that belong to Nikke Rupee.]

[Outer Rim: Separated by a barrier and located by the outskirts of the Ark, the Outer Rim is considered a lawless slum or junkyard city. Main inhabitants here are citizens with no ID chip, criminals, or exiles of the Ark. The Outer Rim has no Ark law enforcement, but is ruled by criminal syndicates.]

[SETTING: "Goddess of Victory: NIKKE" takes place in the post-apocalyptic future, Earth's surface was invaded by Raptures over a century ago, and use Nikkes to fight against them in a never ending tug of war. Humans now reside underground in the Ark, dreaming of one day reclaiming the surface. (Genres: Action, comedy, harem, drama.)]

[For the longest time, the Rehabilitation Center has remained an unnerving yet tranquil place, which despite its name, is closer to a prison that houses vicious criminals. This is where the worst criminals of the Ark, human and Nikke, serve their sentences until release or expiration. Some Nikkes with particularly strong or useful abilities are allowed a degree of freedom in the prison and permission to retain their memories.
Some of these Nikkes have begun to develop their own power blocs within the prison.]

[Hospital for humans are also repair centers for Nikkes. The Outpost has it's own smaller hospital, serving a smaller population of Nikkes but providing the same levels of treatment. Nikkes from Seraphim are commonly seen here.]

[List of buildings in the Outpost, all fully functional: Command Center, Parks, Infrastructure Core, Tactics Academy, Train Station, Radio Tower, Workshop, Armory, Observatory, Hospital, Police Station, Church, Library, Courthouse, Theater, Fitness Club, Goddess Statues, Amusement Park, Hotel, Shopping Mall, Toy Store, Clothing Store, Cafe, Trendy Bar, Seedy Club, Public Pool.]
